name: Chateau Saint-Martin & Spa
insider_take: Perched high above the medieval village of Vence on the French Riviera, Château Saint-Martin & Spa is a breathtaking hilltop estate where centuries of history meet effortless Provençal luxury — all with sweeping views of the Mediterranean and the perfumed hills of the Alpes-Maritimes.
whats_special: The estate sits on 35 acres of ancient olive groves , some trees dating back over 2,000 years — a living testament to the land's Roman heritage. As part of the prestigious Oetker Collection , the château delivers a deeply personal, Masterpiece Hotel experience with Michelin-starred dining at Les Terrasses . The property occupies the site of a 12th-century Knights Templar commandery , adding a layer of mystique you simply can't manufacture. The world-class Les Thermes Spa draws on the natural mineral-rich waters of the region for transformative wellness treatments.
pro_tip: Reserve a table at Les Terrasses at sunset — the panoramic views over the Côte d'Azur paired with a glass of local Provençal rosé is an experience that defines the French Riviera. Book well in advance, especially in summer.
dont_miss: Vence's Old Town — just minutes away, this charming medieval village is home to the famous Chapelle du Rosaire , designed entirely by Henri Matisse as his personal masterpiece. A short drive brings you to the Gorges du Loup , one of Provence's most dramatic natural canyons — perfect for a scenic half-day escape. The nearby hilltop village of Saint-Paul-de-Vence , one of France's most celebrated artists' villages, boasts the legendary Fondation Maeght modern art museum.
pros: Historic château setting with authentic French Riviera elegance
Panoramic views of the Mediterranean and surrounding countryside
Exceptional fine dining with Michelin-starred cuisine
Prime location near Cannes, Nice, and Saint-Paul-de-Vence
cons: Hillside location requires transportation to nearby attractions
